findings.description: No test reaches the second `assertMergeLockHeld` in `fastForward` (after the checkout, before `update-ref`), so deleting it passes the suite, and its refusal-then-restore path is never run. Every current fast-forward test moves the lock before the first assert at L1599. Add a test that renames the lock during the forward `read-tree -m -u`, then asserts the refusal, that main is unchanged, and that the checkout is clean.

The ADR says a refusal "moves nothing" and only a lock lost after the last move ends in `MergeLockLostError`. In `pup land`, though, a lock lost between `fastForward` and the tracking-ref assert (land.service.ts L242) throws a plain Error after main has already moved, so this land returns no MergeLockLostError with its outcome.
